component.name: Currency Converter
component.summary: Instant currency conversions with local caching

description.p: A clean, modern GTK4 utility designed for rapid currency calculations. It utilizes the xe.otek.today API and caches currency pairs locally for up to 6 hours.

screenshot.caption: Main conversion interface showing live rates.

ul.li: Added native search filtering within currency dropdown menus.
Sorted all supported global currencies alphabetically by code.
Packaged as a standalone universal Flatpak distribute bundle.
